FX-CHCOLOR-001.says: The settings as they start: every transform 0, so the drawing, untouched.

FX-CHCOLOR-002.says: Hue transform 120, matching red by hue, tolerance 15: the red column turns green at every darkness, and the skin column, whose hue is within 15 per cent of red's, turns too; everything else stays.

FX-CHCOLOR-003.says: The same with softness 8: the orange and the warm shadow and midtone, just past the tolerance, turn part of the way; the warm highlight, further, stays.

FX-CHCOLOR-004.says: FX-CHCOLOR-003's settings, view mask: the mask as greys, white where the colour is changed fully, black where it is left, grey in between.

FX-CHCOLOR-005.says: FX-CHCOLOR-003's settings, invert on: everything but the reds and skin turns round the wheel; the greys, having no hue, stay grey.

FX-CHCOLOR-006.says: FX-CHCOLOR-004 with invert on: the mask turned round.

FX-CHCOLOR-007.says: Lightness -50: the reds and skin half way to black.

FX-CHCOLOR-008.says: Lightness 50: the reds and skin half way to white.

FX-CHCOLOR-009.says: Saturation -100: the reds and skin turn grey at their own lightness.

FX-CHCOLOR-010.says: Saturation 60, softness 8: the reds stay pure, the skin and the warm tones grow stronger.

FX-CHCOLOR-011.says: Matching by RGB, colour #f6d6be (the skin), tolerance 20, softness 10, hue 180 and lightness -30: the skin and the colours close to it in all three channels, the warm highlight and white among them, are changed; red, far in RGB, is not.

FX-CHCOLOR-012.says: Matching by chroma, colour #00ff00, tolerance 30, softness 15, hue 180: the bright greens are changed, the darker greens, whose colour signal is weaker, less, and cyan, near in hue but far in chroma, not at all.

FX-CHCOLOR-013.says: Hue transform keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 240 at frame 4, linear, softness 8: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 FX-CHCOLOR-003, frame 4 the reds turned blue.

FX-CHCOLOR-014.says: FX-CHCOLOR-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-CHCOLOR-015.says: Hue transform 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHCOLOR-016.says: Lightness transform 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHCOLOR-017.says: Saturation transform -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHCOLOR-018.says: Tolerance 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHCOLOR-019.says: Softness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CHCOLOR-020.says: Color to change "#ff00", which is not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
